statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-6952 is a double free in another_hunk() in src/pch.c of GNU patch through 2.7.6, reached through pch_swap() with a crafted context diff that has a blank line in the middle of a hunk (https://savannah.gnu.org/bugs/?53133, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-6952). Upstream fixed it in https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/patch.git/commit/?id=9c986353e420ead6e706262bf204d6e03322c300 (Fix swapping fake lines in pch_swap, August 2018), which corrects how pch_swap() moves the non-freeable fake-line range so that those lines are never freed. That fix is in GNU patch 2.8: its ChangeLog carries the entry, and pch_swap() in the shipped src/pch.c computes the shifted range as p_end - p_ptrn_lines (https://sources.debian.org/src/patch/2.8-2/src/pch.c/). Debian rates the issue unimportant and lists 2.8-2 as vulnerable only because it records no fixed version. Every build of this package is built from upstream GNU patch 2.8, through Debian source package patch 2.8-2, and contains the fix. The fixed version is the lowest build in the package's current version scheme and the only one the DHI Debian repository now publishes; one older build from the retired version scheme sorts below it and so reads as affected, although it also contains the fix.
